messages:
maya: Quick async check — kicking off gradual rollout for feature flag `rlw_new_routing` (prod) at 2% canary. Goals: verify p95 latency, error rate, and no regression on fallback paths. I'll post metrics in a bit.

aj: Copy. I'll watch the canary dashboard and alerts. Ping me if SLOs creep.

keiko: Noted. I enabled verbose tracing for the first 5k requests to capture routing decisions (temp).

maya: Thanks @keiko. Can you also confirm no schema changes required for the rollout?

keiko: No schema changes. Just routing logic. DB untouched. :+1:

sam: Heads-up — the config PR is still awaiting one LGTM (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/823). I can merge once we confirm canary health.

maya: Cool. Leaving PR as gating step. If canary looks good for 30m we merge and bump to 10%.

deploy-bot: deploy started by maya at 2024-09-12T10:14:36Z — rlw_new_routing @ 2% canary. Instance group: routing-prod-a.

keiko: First 10 minutes: p95 latency stable at 190ms (baseline 185ms), error rate 0.02% (baseline 0.01%). Small blip at +6m with 502 from backend-x, investigating.
notes: This thread is a short async rollout check-in: initial canary at 2%, monitoring, PR gating and plan to increase to 10% after 30m stable.
